This is actually an ongoing test program and has been since the beginning of the Minuteman missile evolution. It's the way I started my AF career, incidentally, as part of it. Years ago we used to test launch maybe up to a dozen plus or more a year, but they've scaled back considerably. They literally pull an operational, on alert missile from an ICBM silo, transport it to Vandenberg, and then with specialized telemetry equipment on board and a non-nuclear warhead, of course, test launch it to our test range at Kwajalein Atoll, Marshall Islands. We likely are down to fewer than six +/- a year and the program is designed to ensure that the operational fleet out there are still effective. A check to see that guidance systems and rocketry, that kind of stuff is fully capable and functioning to specs. Any anomalies found in telemetry data are addressed throughout the fleet, when discovered. All our missile type defense forces have similar programs, launching from sea (sub launched), or even Cape Canaveral.
